title: Philippe Groffey (?) to Ferenc Rákóczi II (Pompeio Cesoni), 15 October 1707 (DECODE R902)

documents.shelfmark: MNL OL, G15 Caps. C. Fasc. 39, pp. 277-279 (DECODE R902)

plaintext.source: No prior plaintext found; this project decoded the document with preserved key DECODE R639 (Fasc. 44/08).

transcription.notes: Manual DECODE transcription contains many one-digit errors, joined groups, and ambiguous raised leading digits.

system.summary: One-part numerical French nomenclator, values 10-560, with homophonic letters, endings, syllables, words, names, places, and nulls.
system.notes: Key heading: De Monsieur de Bonac et Graffei.

conditions.human_role: Supplied access to the authenticated DECODE session and posed the target.

solution.what: Read the clear address A Monsieur / Monsieur Pompeio Cesoni.
Located and applied DECODE R639, Fasc. 44/08, headed De Monsieur de Bonac et Graffei.
Validated the key on same-series known-plaintext documents R852 and R912.
Recovered 1,020 of 1,108 transcribed groups and read the report in substance.
Attributed the unsigned report to Philippe Groffey from the key heading, subject, and diplomatic role.

gaps.item: R902 (pp. 277-279), ~88 unparsed or impossible groups and the continuous diplomatic text
gaps.detail: residue is DECODE transcription slips (one-digit errors, joined groups); no fresh group-by-group transcription from the two cipher leaves has been made, though the images were viewable through the project account

outcome.notes: Cipher solved. Exact diplomatic edition awaits a fresh manuscript transcription because the existing DECODE digit transcript is noisy.
